( HRE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' or HRE.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
hre.POSITION = #POSITION:VARCHAR#
hre.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
hre.post_grade_no = #POST_GRADE_NO:VARCHAR#
hre.emp_type_code = #EMP_TYPE_CODE:VARCHAR#

( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO B WHERE B.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND B.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# AND ROWNUM = 1 ) OR HRE.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId# )

EXISTS( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND HR_DEPARTMENT.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH (HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# OR #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# = '') CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )

SELECT HRE.EMPID, HRE.LOCAL_NAME, get_dept_name(HRE.DEPTNO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)DEPTNAME, get_global_name(HRE.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POST_GRADE, get_global_name(HRE.POSITION,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)POSITION_NAME, HRE.EMP_OFFICE, get_global_name(HRE.EMP_OFFICE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)EMP_OFFICE_NAME, get_global_name(HRE.EMP_TYPE_CODE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#)EMP_TYPE, HRE.ID_CARD_NO, HRE.WORK_HOUR_TYPE, TO_CHAR(HRE.DATE_STARTED,'YYYY.MM.DD')DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(HRE.END_PROBATION_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD')END_PROBATION_DATE, CASE WHEN HRE.END_PROBATION_DATE <= SYSDATE THEN 'N'ELSE 'Y'END PROBATION_YN, TO_CHAR(HRE.DATE_LEFT,'YYYY.MM.DD')DATE_LEFT, get_work_area_name(hre.cpny_id,hre.WORK_AREA,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) WORK_AREA_NAME, HPI.PHOTO_PATH, HRE.PERSON_ID, get_global_name(HRE.DUTY_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NAME, HRE.DUTY_NO, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(HRE.DATE_LEFT,SYSDATE),HRE.DATE_STARTED)/12) || '年' || TRUNC(MOD(MONTHS_BETWEEN(NVL(HRE.DATE_LEFT,SYSDATE),HRE.DATE_STARTED),12)) || '个月' WORK_TIME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HRE,HR_PERSONAL_INFO HPI WHERE HRE.PERSON_ID = HPI.PERSON_ID AND HRE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT * FROM (SELECT get_global_name(TT.SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_NAME, TO_CHAR(TT.START_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') START_DATE, get_emp_local_name(TT.CREATED_BY,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) || ' ' || TT.CREATED_IP CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(TT.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') CREATE_DATE FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT TT WHERE TT.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY TT.START_DATE DESC) MYDATA WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT HAR.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(HAR.START_DATE, 'DD-MM-YYYY') START_DATE, get_global_name(HAR.SHIFT_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_NAME, HAR.REMARK FROM AR_SHIFTGROUP_MANAGEMENT HAR,HR_EMPLOYEE HRE WHERE HAR.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND HAR.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT TO_CHAR(C.DDATE, 'dd.MM.yyyy') DDATE, CASE WHEN C.IWEEK = 0 THEN 'CN' ELSE TO_CHAR(C.IWEEK + 1) END IWEEK, get_global_name(C.TYPEID,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DATETYPENAME, get_global_name(c.shift_no,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) SHIFT_NAME, SUBSTR(get_ar_shift_time(c.shift_no,TO_CHAR(DDATE, 'yyyyMMdd'),c.cpny_id,'FIRST'),12,5) || '~' || SUBSTR(get_ar_shift_time(c.shift_no,TO_CHAR(DDATE, 'yyyyMMdd'),c.cpny_id,'LAST'),12,5) WORKTIME FROM AR_CALENDER_GROUP C WHERE C.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND C.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_FIRST_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#DDATE:VARCHAR#,'MMYYYY'),'YYYYMM'),#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'') AND GET_AR_LAST_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#DDATE:VARCHAR#,'MMYYYY'),'YYYYMM'),#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'') AND C.GROUP_ID = #SHIFT_NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY IYEAR, IMONTH, IDAY

SELECT TO_CHAR(C.DDATE, 'dd.MM.yyyy') DDATE, CASE WHEN C.IWEEK = 0 THEN 'CN' ELSE TO_CHAR(C.IWEEK + 1) END IWEEK, S1.CONTENT DATETYPENAME, S2.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME, SUBSTR(get_ar_shift_time(c.shift_no,TO_CHAR(DDATE, 'yyyyMMdd'),c.cpny_id,'FIRST'),12,5) || '~' || SUBSTR(get_ar_shift_time(c.shift_no,TO_CHAR(DDATE, 'yyyyMMdd'),c.cpny_id,'LAST'),12,5) WORKTIME, AS010.SHIFT_SHORTNAME FROM AR_CALENDER C, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S2, AR_SHIFT010 AS010 WHERE C.TYPEID = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage# AND C.SHIFT_NO = S2.NO(+) AND S2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage# AND C.SHIFT_NO = AS010.SHIFT_NO(+) AND C.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND C.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_FIRST_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#DDATE:VARCHAR#,'MMYYYY'),'YYYYMM'),#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'') AND GET_AR_LAST_DATE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#DDATE:VARCHAR#,'MMYYYY'),'YYYYMM'),#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#,'')
ORDER BY IYEAR, IMONTH, IDAY
